instruction: Candid outdoor full-length photograph of a couple walking on a dirt path in a sunny autumn park. On the left, the woman in the long black coat (R1) walks forward in blue jeans and white sneakers, looking down. On the right, the man in the black puffer jacket (R2) walks beside her in black cargo pants and light sneakers. They hold hands, her left hand clasped in his right hand, as they stroll forward. The background features bare trees and soft sunlight. The scene is illuminated by warm, direct sunlight casting soft shadows.
